segments.name: RNA based therapeutics
segments.description: Clinical-stage biotechnology company discovering and developing innovative RNA editing therapeutics for liver and CNS diseases.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one reportable segment, which comprises the discovery and development of innovative, RNA based therapeutics.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from collaboration partners such as Lilly under its licensing and research collaboration, and receives grants and funding from patient organizations and government institutions.
revenueModel.evidence: In addition to advancing our wholly-owned pipeline programs, we entered into a global licensing and research collaboration with Eli Lilly and Company ("Lilly") in September 2021.
